correctness.rationale: The assigned graph of A_d is (K_{d-3}∨C4)□K2, giving Laplacian spectrum 0,2,d-1 twice,d+1 with d copies,d+3 with d-2 copies; matrix-tree theorem yields the stated τ(A_d). The B_d graph is specified by truncating one simple triangular-prism vertex and replacing it by a d-clique; exchanging the paired classes splits its Laplacian into (r-1) copies of 2×2 T_d, one 3×3 S_d with eigenvalues d+1,d+1±√2, and a 7-cell quotient Q_r for r=d-3≥1. Independently evaluating det of Q_r with its singleton C row/column removed gives exactly (r+3)(r³+12r²+44r+46) as a symbolic polynomial identity; the graph spectrum and matrix-tree formula yield τ(B_d) for d≥4. The d=3 eight-vertex cofactor is 336, vs τ(A_3)=384. An independent SymPy graph construction and exact integer Laplacian cofactors for all d=3..9 matched the formulas. The rational comparison difference after h=d-3 independently expands to h⁵+18h⁴+124h³+406h²+628h+372>0; asymptotic factors each contribute -1/d. The symbolic identity plus invariant decomposition prove all dimensions, not the finite enumerations.
residual_risks: Independent bounded graph checks d=3..9 alone are not proofs for all d; general proof rests on verified symbolic quotient and group-invariant decomposition.
